Subject: Payment rails question — EUR invoice 2027-07-INV-312

Hi Chloe,

We're ready to settle invoice 2027-07-INV-312 but our treasury has a couple of questions before we initiate the wire:

1) Do you require gross or net payment? Specifically, will Redwood absorb any intermediary (correspondent) bank fees that might be taken en route to your EUR beneficiary account, or should we send an amount that includes an estimated intermediary fee so Redwood receives the net invoice amount?

2) If we remit in USD instead of EUR (ours is a USD pool), will Redwood accept a USD wire and apply your FX, or do you require EUR only to match the invoice?

3) Any special instructions for the beneficiary reference so remittance is automatically picked up?

Please advise the preferred flow and any wire template details. We want to avoid shortpayments and delays.

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear questions. Below is our standard approach plus a couple of options depending on what works best for GammaApps. Attaching a wire template (wire_template_0707.csv) and a remittance note for reference.

Short answers up front:
- Default: Redwood expects the invoice amount to be RECEIVED net by Redwood (beneficiary net). That means intermediary/correspondent fees are typically deducted en route and are not billed back to the payer; however, to avoid shortpayments we prefer customers either: 1) send the gross amount (invoice + estimated intermediary fees) so we receive the full invoice total, OR 2) send to our EUR beneficiary account and mark the payment as "BENEFICIARY WILL COVER ALL CHARGES" where your bank supports that option.
- If you pay in USD: we can accept USD wires, but we will apply our standard FX conversion (our treasury/FX provider rate + small spread). For large/recurring payments we can discuss locking an FX rate.

Details / recommended flows:
Option A — Preferred (EUR gross to ensure net receipt)
- Instruct your bank to send the amount: EUR [invoice total] + estimated intermediary fees.
- Use beneficiary: Redwood Inference GmbH (for EU receipts)
- IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00
- BIC/SWIFT: REWDDEFFXXX
- Field: Invoice 2027-07-INV-312 / GammaApps
- Payment instruction: SHA or BEN is acceptable if your bank can guarantee no intermediary deduction; best practice is to confirm "OUR CHARGES" vs "BENEFICIARY CHARGES" with your bank.

Option B — USD wire (we convert)
- Send USD to our USD collection account — include invoice reference. We will convert and apply the payment to the EUR invoice. Expect an FX spread; we will post the converted amount and notify you of any shortfalls.

Notes on fees:
- Correspondent/intermediary fees are outside Redwood's control and often inconsistent by routing. We will not normally invoice you for typical intermediary fees, but we will flag material shortfalls and request top-up if remittance results in underpayment of the invoice.

If GammaApps prefers Redwood to explicitly absorb intermediary fees for this single renewal as a concession, I can escalate for approval (please see internal note below).

Next steps:
- Let me know which option you want (EUR gross vs USD).
- If you want Redwood to absorb up to a cap, state the cap and I will request approval.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0191

- Our EUR beneficiary (preferred) for this case: Redwood Inference GmbH — IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 — BIC REWDDEFFXXX
